ordered_steps: Search supplier by organization number 858573483 via supplier endpoint
If not found, create supplier with name 'Fossekraft AS', organization number '858573483', address 'Sjøgata 127, 3015 Drammen', bank account '76767487637'
Resolve supplier ID for Fossekraft AS
Validate ledger account 6340 exists and is allowed for supplier invoice posting
Resolve input VAT code/mapping for 25% incoming VAT
Create supplier invoice for supplier ID with invoice number 'INV-2026-2464', invoice date '2026-05-07', due date '2026-06-06', currency 'NOK' if required
Add invoice line/booking with description 'Skylagring', account 6340, net amount 55350, VAT rate 25%
If API requires totals validation, reconcile document total 69187 against net/VAT discrepancy and use document-stated VAT 13837 if supported
Confirm registered supplier invoice status and stored totals

planned_endpoints.summary: Create supplier. Related supplier addresses may also be created.
Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.

rules: When email is provided, ALWAYS set BOTH email AND invoiceEmail to the same value.
ALWAYS include phoneNumber if provided in the prompt — scoring checks phone.
ALWAYS include postalAddress with addressLine1, postalCode, city, country={id: 161} when address info is provided.
Use ?number=XXXX to resolve a specific account number to its ID.
Do NOT use other query params — they are not supported.
Do NOT use /ledger/accountingPeriod — it does not exist.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.
POSTING BALANCE RULES (which determines single-leg vs manual-leg):
vatType != 0 (e.g. id=3 for 25%): include ONLY the debit posting with GROSS amount. Tripletex auto-generates VAT + credit.
vatType == 0 (exempt): include BOTH debit AND credit postings manually. They must sum to 0.
If you get 422 'postings don't sum to 0': you used vatType=0 but only one posting. Either add the credit posting manually OR change to the correct vatType (e.g. 3 for 25%).
NEVER default to vatType=0 for standard purchases — use vatType=3 (25%) unless explicitly VAT-exempt.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Resolve account numbers: GET /ledger/account with params={"number": XXXX}, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.

I'll create the supplier and resolve the expense account in parallel, then register the voucher.

payload.headline: Supplier created and voucher posted, but only 1/6 scoring checks passed (wrong invoice type).
what_went_wrong: Used POST /ledger/voucher instead of POST /supplierInvoice — the task requires a proper supplier invoice, not a manual voucher, causing 5/6 checks to fail.
Two 422 validation errors from voucher attempts: first with vatType=1 (no auto-balance), then vatType=11 — both failed because the AP credit posting was missing initially.
The /ledger/account GET call was made twice (once for 6340, once for 2400) — the second could have been avoided by knowing account 2400's ID in advance.
Scoring checks likely verify invoice-specific fields (invoiceNumber, dueDate, supplierInvoice linkage) that a raw voucher does not populate.
what_worked: Supplier Fossekraft AS was created correctly with org number, address, and bank account on first attempt.
Final voucher balanced correctly with expense account 6340, vatType=11 (25% input VAT), and AP credit to 2400.
what_to_try_next: Use POST /supplierInvoice endpoint instead of /ledger/voucher — this registers a proper supplier invoice with invoiceNumber, invoiceDate, dueDate, and supplier linkage that the scoring checks verify.
In the supplierInvoice payload, include invoiceNumber='INV-2026-2464', invoiceDate='2026-05-07', paymentDueDate='2026-06-06', and orderLines with account 6340 and vatType id=11.
Eliminate the second GET /ledger/account call by hardcoding or caching account 2400 ID — and skip the first failed voucher attempt by including the AP credit posting from the start.
unnecessary_calls: POST /ledger/voucher (first attempt, vatType=1, missing AP credit) — should have included credit posting from the start
POST /ledger/voucher (second attempt, vatType=11, still missing AP credit) — same structural mistake repeated
GET /ledger/account (second call for account 2400) — could be avoided by knowing standard AP account ID
